name: Philip Oswald Descartes
source: An old and calm soul that’s lived quite an adventurous life and is contently living out his days as a professor while taking care of his son Richard. He’s extremely friendly but also comes off as a bit of a goofball who might not be as learned as his age and profession would suggest. Nevertheless, he seems to be determined to win even if it means that he’s putting his son in danger…
